t: When you are asked to carry more than you were
a: أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
p: A-lam nashraḥ laka ṣadrak, wa waḍaʿnā ʿanka wizrak, alladhī anqaḍa ẓahrak, wa rafaʿnā laka dhikrak.
m: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast? And We removed from you your burden Which had weighed upon your back And raised high for you your repute.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
